name: OpenVibe.SDK

conditions: manual: consumers pin release tags; going back means pinning the previous tag in package.json and redeploying the consumer
rollback.window: any time; a published tag is never moved or deleted
blockers: a consumer that already uses an API added in the newer tag must drop that use first

contracts.none: no manifest range: it pins openvibe-contracts v0.49.0 in package.json

notes: Supported browser and server clients for the OpenVibe platform (openvibe-sdk). A released library, not a runtime: tagged releases installed from https://codeload.github.com/OpenVibers/OpenVibe.SDK/tar.gz/refs/tags/<tag> (v0.4.0 on 2026-09-23). Nothing to deploy or poll.
